title: Data types the content schemas share

quaternion.description: Quaternion [x, y, z, w], [0, 0, 0, 1] when left out

id.description: Unique within the file, lowercase letters and digits with dashes, e.g. ne-brontodon-01

source.description: Where an imported entry came from, e.g. a replay or capture entity

edited.description: Set once a person changed an imported entry, a re-import leaves it alone then

notes.description: Free text, instead of comments, which tools don't keep
